Sam (AM, us): Quick monthly touch-base -- anything on your side?
Lena (Office Manager, customer): Nope, all is well. Using it the same as always.

Lena: Thanks, talk next month.

Call -- Atlas Manufacturing -- Incident review
Participants: Reggie (Senior AM, us) / Nadia (VP Operations, customer) / Tom (IT Lead, customer)

Reggie: I want to start by acknowledging the outage on Tuesday. Three hours of downtime during your shift change is serious.
Nadia: It is. That is the second unplanned outage this quarter. My line supervisors could not log jobs and we had to fall back to paper.
Tom: And we still do not have a clear explanation of what happened.
Reggie: Understood. Here is what I will commit to: engineering will deliver a full root-cause analysis by Wednesday, in writing.
Nadia: I need that. And frankly I expect some acknowledgment on the commercial side.
Reggie: Agreed -- we will credit the affected month's fees on your next invoice.
Nadia: Okay. That helps. But I will be honest, our renewal is in four months and leadership is asking whether we have bet on the wrong platform.
Reggie: I hear that, and I do not take it lightly. Root cause Wednesday, credit on the next invoice, and I will set up a reliability review with our engineering director.
Tom: Send us the analysis and we will review it with the team.
Nadia: Let us see the analysis first, then talk next steps.

next_steps: Deliver the written root-cause analysis by Wednesday.
Credit the affected month's fees on the next invoice.
Set up the reliability review with our engineering director.
Customer to review the root-cause analysis with their team.
risks: Second unplanned outage this quarter; leadership is questioning the platform ahead of the renewal in four months.
commitments: Engineering will deliver a written root-cause analysis by Wednesday.
We will credit the affected month's fees on the next invoice.
We will set up a reliability review with our engineering director.

Call -- Willowbrook Health -- Growth planning
Participants: Tara (Senior AM, us) / Dr. Alan Fisk (Chief Medical Officer, customer) / Bianca (Operations Manager, customer)

Tara: It has been a strong year -- your cardiology department has fully adopted the platform.
Alan: We are thrilled. Honestly it has changed how our teams coordinate.
Bianca: The nurses actually like it, which never happens with new software.
Tara: That is wonderful to hear. I know you had mentioned wanting to bring on the neurology department next.
Alan: Yes, let us move on that. Can you put together a quote?
Tara: Absolutely -- I will send an expansion quote for the neurology department this week.
Bianca: Great. We will get you their user count by tomorrow.
Tara: One more thing -- would you be open to being a reference for other health systems evaluating us?
Alan: Happy to. We believe in it. Have your marketing team reach out to Bianca to set it up.
Tara: Thank you, that means a lot. I will coordinate the reference details with Bianca's team.

next_steps: Send an expansion quote for the neurology department this week.
Coordinate the reference-call details with the customer's operations team.
Customer to provide the neurology department user count by tomorrow.
Customer agreed to act as a reference for other health systems.
commitments: We will send an expansion quote for the neurology department this week.
We will coordinate the reference-call details with the customer's operations team.
